nodes.notes: Son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; ancestor of King Gandhara (eponym of Gandhara / NW Pakistan-Afghanistan) and Prachetas, whose 100 sons migrate north/west across the Indus into Central Asia (Mleccha kingdoms) in Puranic ethnography!

nodes.name: 4. Anu → Ushinara (King Shibi) & Titikshu (Anga, Vanga, Kalinga)
nodes.notes: Son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; splits into Ushinara (self-sacrificing King Shibi & Madra/Kekaya in Punjab) and Titikshu -> King Bali -> 5 Eastern Kingdoms (Anga, Vanga [Bengal], Kalinga [Odisha], Pundra, Suhma)!

nodes.name: 5. Puru (Pauravas — Inheritor of Central Realm)
nodes.notes: Youngest son of Yayati & Sharmishtha; trades his youth to restore his father's vigor and inherits the central throne leading to Bharata, Kuru, and the Mahabharata!

nodes.name: Sahasrajit (→ Kartavirya Arjuna) & Kroshtu → Satvata → Vrishni → Shurasena
nodes.notes: Sahasrajit -> Haihaya -> thousand-armed Emperor Kartavirya Arjuna; Kroshtu -> Satvata -> Andhaka & Vrishni -> Shurasena (grandfather of Krishna and the Pandavas!).

nodes.name: Vasudeva (+ Devaki & Rohini) & Sister Kunti (Pritha)
nodes.role: Parents of Krishna/Balarama & Mother of the Pandavas
nodes.notes: Children of Shurasena: Vasudeva fathers Krishna, Balarama, and Subhadra; his sister Kunti marries Kuru prince Pandu, making Krishna and the Pandavas first cousins!

nodes.name: Krishna (+ Rukmini), Balarama & Subhadra → Pradyumna → Vajra
nodes.role: Speaker of the Bhagavad Gita & Lords of Dvaraka
nodes.notes: Krishna (8th Avatar of Vishnu) & Balarama rule Dvaraka; Krishna's sister Subhadra marries Pandava Arjuna (birthing Abhimanyu!), while Krishna's son Pradyumna -> Aniruddha -> Vajra survives the fall of Dvaraka to rule Indraprastha!

nodes.name: Dushyanta (+ Shakuntala) → Emperor Bharata (Eponym of India!)
nodes.notes: King Dushyanta (descendant of Puru) marries Shakuntala (daughter of Sage Vishvamitra & Menaka), birthing Emperor Bharata — who gives India its classical name Bharatavarsha!

nodes.name: Hasti (Hastinapura) → Ajamidha (→ Panchala/Drupada) → King Kuru
nodes.notes: Hasti founds Hastinapura; Ajamidha branches into Panchala (King Drupada -> Draupadi & Dhrishtadyumna) and Samvarana (+ Tapati, daughter of Surya!) -> King Kuru (eponym of Kurukshetra & Kauravas)!

nodes.name: King Shantanu (+ Ganga → Bhishma; + Satyavati) & Sage Vyasa
nodes.role: Patriarchs of Hastinapura & Compiler of the Vedas
nodes.notes: Shantanu + Goddess Ganga -> Bhishma (vow of celibacy); Shantanu + Satyavati -> Vichitravirya. Satyavati's elder son Sage Vyasa (by Rishi Parashara, great-grandson of Vashishta!) compiles the 4 Vedas & Mahabharata and sires Dhritarashtra, Pandu, and Vidura!

nodes.name: Dhritarashtra (+ Gandhari) → Duryodhana, Dushasana & 100 Kauravas
nodes.notes: Blind King Dhritarashtra marries Princess Gandhari of Gandhara (sister of Shakuni — uniting Kuru and NW Gandhara!), fathering Duryodhana, 99 brothers, and daughter Duhshala.

nodes.name: Pandu (+ Kunti & Madri) → Karna & ALL 5 Pandavas (+ Draupadi)
nodes.notes: Kunti bears Karna (by Surya) and Yudhishthira, Bhima (-> Ghatotkacha), & Arjuna; Madri (princess of Madra!) bears twins Nakula & Sahadeva. All 5 Pandavas wed Draupadi (Princess of Panchala); Arjuna also weds Krishna's sister Subhadra -> Abhimanyu!

nodes.name: Abhimanyu (+ Uttara) → King Parikshit → King Janamejaya
nodes.era: Dawn of Kali Yuga (Vishnu Purana IV.21)
nodes.notes: Abhimanyu (son of Arjuna & Subhadra, uniting Kurus & Yadavas!) fathers Parikshit (saved in the womb by Krishna); at his son Janamejaya's serpent sacrifice, Vaishampayana first recites the Mahabharata!

nodes.name: Magadha (Jarasandha → Bimbisara) → Chandragupta Maurya → Emperor Ashoka
nodes.role: Unifier of India & Global Inscription Bridge (Greece, Egypt & Asia!)
nodes.notes: Chandragupta Maurya (mentored by Chanakya) defeats Alexander's successor Seleucus I (305 BCE) and seals a marriage alliance with the Seleucid house! His grandson Emperor Ashoka the Great explicitly names Ptolemy II of Egypt, Antiochus II of Syria, and Macedon in Rock Edict XIII while sending Buddhist missions across Asia!

nodes.name: Alara of Kush (Founder of Napatan Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Unified Upper Nubia around Napata (Jebel Barkal); revered by all later Kushite pharaohs as their founding ancestor.

nodes.name: Kashta & Queen Pebatjma
nodes.role: Brother of Alara / First Kushite King in Upper Egypt
nodes.notes: Extended Kushite rule into Upper Egypt and installed his daughter Amenirdis I as God's Wife of Amun at Thebes; father of Piye and Shabaka.

nodes.name: Piye (Piankhi) & Shabaka (25th Dynasty Pharaohs)
nodes.role: Kushite Conquerors & Restorers of Unified Egypt
nodes.notes: Piye conquered all of Egypt from Nubia to the Delta; his brother Shabaka preserved the ancient Memphite Theology of Ptah on the Shabaka Stone!

nodes.name: Shebitku & Taharqa (Biblical Tirhakah, King of Cush!)
nodes.role: Greatest 25th Dynasty Pharaoh — Named in 2 Kings 19:9
nodes.notes: Son of Piye; explicitly named in the Bible as 'Tirhakah, King of Cush' who marched to relieve King Hezekiah's Jerusalem from Assyrian Emperor Sennacherib (701 BCE)!

nodes.name: Tantamani → Aspelta → Ergamenes (Meroe)
nodes.role: Last Kushite Pharaoh of Egypt → Founders of Meroe
nodes.notes: Tantamani (son of Shabaka) was the last 25th Dynasty king in Egypt; Aspelta shifted the royal capital south to Meroe (creating the Meroitic script and pyramid fields!).

nodes.name: Queen Shanakdakhete → Amanirenas → Amanitore (Kandakes)
nodes.notes: Meroe was ruled by powerful Candaces (Kandakes): Amanirenas battled Roman Augustus's legions (capturing his bronze head at Meroe!), and Queen Amanitore corresponds to 'Candace, Queen of the Ethiopians' in Acts 8:27!

nodes.name: King Kikanos of Cush (+ Queen Adoniah) → Menakrus
nodes.role: Cushite Royal House in Moses's 40-Year Reign
nodes.notes: Book of Jasher 72-76 recounts Moses aiding King Kikanos against the rebel Balaam, marrying Queen Adoniah, and ruling Cush for 40 years before turning the kingdom over to Kikanos's son Menakrus!

nodes.name: Ityopis (Ethiopic, son of Cush) → Aksumawi
nodes.role: Traditional Eponym of Ethiopia & Founder of Aksum
nodes.notes: Traditional Ethiopian royal chronicles trace Ethiopia directly from Ham -> Cush -> Ityopis (eponym of Ethiopia) -> Aksumawi (founder of Aksum) -> Malakya Aksum!

nodes.name: Arwe (Serpent King) → Angabo → Gedur → Tawasya
nodes.role: Slayer of Arwe & Ancestors of Queen Makeda
nodes.notes: Angabo slays the tyrant serpent-king Arwe and founds the Agazian dynasty of Aksum leading directly to Queen Makeda!

nodes.name: Queen Makeda (Queen of Sheba / Saba / Bilqis)
nodes.era: c. 10th c. BCE trad. (1 Kings 10 / Kebra Nagast)
nodes.role: Sovereign of Aksum & Sheba / Mother of Menelik I
nodes.notes: Journeys from Aksum/Sheba to Jerusalem to test King Solomon's wisdom; bears Menelik I, uniting the lineages of Judah/Israel, Saba/Arabia, and Cush/Ethiopia!

nodes.name: Zagduru → Bazen → Emperor Ezana & King Kaleb of Aksum
nodes.role: First Christian Emperor of Aksum (c. 330 CE)
nodes.notes: King Bazen reigned at the turn of the 1st century CE; Emperor Ezana converted Aksum to Christianity (c. 330 CE) and conquered Meroe; King Kaleb (Ella Atsbeha) campaigned in Himyar/Yemen!

nodes.name: Mara Takla Haymanot → Emperor Gebre Mesqel Lalibela (Zagwe)
nodes.role: Carver of Rock-Hewn Churches (Trad. Line of Moses & Zipporah)
nodes.notes: Ethiopian Zagwe chronicles trace the Zagwe kings to a daughter of the Aksumite line AND traditionally claim descent from Moses & Zipporah! Lalibela carved the 11 monolithic churches of 'New Jerusalem'.

nodes.name: Yekuno Amlak → Zara Yaqob → Menelik II → Haile Selassie I
nodes.notes: Yekuno Amlak restored the Solomonic Dynasty in 1270 CE; continued through Zara Yaqob, Menelik II (victor at Adwa), down to Haile Selassie I (225th ruler from Menelik I!).

nodes.name: Olodumare → Obatala & Oduduwa (Progenitor of the Yoruba)
nodes.role: Founding Ancestor of Yoruba & Benin Kingdoms
sources: Samuel Johnson History of the Yorubas
nodes.notes: In indigenous Ifa cosmology, Olodumare sends Obatala and Oduduwa to establish Ile-Ife (cradle of humanity). A later 19th-c. syncretic oral chronicle (Samuel Johnson) compares Oduduwa's eastern migration to 'Lamurudu' (Nimrod) from the East!

nodes.name: Okanbi (Son of Oduduwa)
nodes.role: Father of the 7 Crowned Yoruba Monarchs
nodes.notes: Only son of Oduduwa in core Ife genealogy; father of 7 royal children who founded the major Yoruba kingdoms and the Benin dynasty.

nodes.name: Bayajidda (Abuyazidu of Baghdad) + Queen Daurama → Bawo
nodes.role: Progenitor of the 7 Hausa Bakwai Kingdoms
nodes.notes: Prince Bayajidda journeys from Baghdad across Bornu to Daura (Nigeria), slays the well-serpent Sarki, weds Queen Magajiya Daurama, and sires Bawo — father of the 7 Hausa Bakwai states (Daura, Kano, Katsina, Zaria, Gobir, Rano, Biram)!

nodes.name: Bilali Bounama → Naré Maghann → Sundiata Keita → Mansa Musa
nodes.role: Founder of the Mali Empire (Lion King of Manden)
nodes.notes: Mande royal griots trace the Keita dynasty from Bilali Bounama (traditionally linked to Bilal ibn Rabah, Ethiopian companion of Muhammad!) to Sundiata Keita (founder of Mali, 1235 CE) and Mansa Musa!

nodes.name: Mazigh → Baranis & Botr → Queen Dihya (Imazighen / Berbers)
nodes.role: Eponymous Ancestor of the Amazigh (Berber) Peoples
nodes.notes: Imazighen ('Free People', attested in Herodotus as Maxyes and Egyptian inscriptions as Meshwesh!). Medieval North African genealogists (Ibn Khaldun) linked Mazigh to Ham's sons Phut/Canaan, branching into the Baranis & Botr confederations and heroic Queen Dihya (al-Kahina).

nodes.name: Kintu & Nambi (Buganda) / Gikuyu & Mumbi (Kikuyu)
nodes.role: First Human Couples of Great Lakes & East Africa
nodes.notes: Kintu & Nambi (daughter of sky-king Ggulu) are the primeval progenitors of Buganda's Kabaka kings; Gikuyu & Mumbi (created near Mt. Kenya by Ngai) are the progenitors of the nine Kikuyu clans (Nyumba ya Mumbi).

nodes.name: Oranmiyan (Oranyan — Founder of Oyo & Benin Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Youngest and mightiest grandson of Oduduwa; founded the Oyo Empire (father of Ajaka & Shango!) and fathered Eweka I, founder of the Oba Dynasty of Benin!

nodes.name: Eweka I (First Oba of Benin, son of Oranmiyan)
nodes.notes: Son of Oranmiyan & Princess Erinmwinde of Benin; founder of the historic Oba Dynasty of the Kingdom of Benin.

nodes.name: Olowu of Owu
nodes.notes: 1st crowned grandchild of Oduduwa (son of Okanbi's eldest daughter).

nodes.name: Alaketu of Ketu
nodes.notes: Founder of the Yoruba kingdom of Ketu (Benin Republic/Nigeria).

nodes.name: Onisabe of Sabe
nodes.notes: Founder of the kingdom of Sabe.

nodes.name: Olupopo of Popo
nodes.notes: Founder of the Popo kingdom.

nodes.name: Orangun of Ila
nodes.notes: Founder of the kingdom of Ila-Orangun.

nodes.name: Bagauda (Kano) & Daura
nodes.notes: Founding Hausa Bakwai kingdoms descended from Bawo.

nodes.name: Kumayau (Katsina) & Gunguma (Zaria/Zazzau)
nodes.notes: Founding Hausa Bakwai kingdoms (Zaria later famed for Warrior Queen Amina!).

nodes.name: Duma (Gobir), Zamna Kogi (Rano) & Biram
nodes.notes: Founding Hausa Bakwai kingdoms.

nodes.name: Chaos → Gaia (Earth) & Uranus (Sky)
nodes.notes: Out of Chaos emerges Gaia (Earth), who births Uranus (Starry Sky); their union generates the 12 Titans.

nodes.name: Cronus (Kronos) & Rhea
nodes.notes: Youngest Titan who overthrows Uranus; parents of the six elder Olympians (Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Hestia, Hades). In Phoenician Sanchuniathon, El is equated with Kronos!

nodes.name: Iapetus (Titan) & Clymene / Asia
nodes.notes: Titan father of Atlas, Prometheus, Epimetheus, and Menoetius — frequently compared by classical and biblical scholars to Noah's son Japheth (Hebrew Yefet <-> Greek Iapetos)!

nodes.name: Oceanus & Tethys / Hyperion & Coeus
nodes.notes: Oceanus & Tethys sire the 3,000 River Gods (including Inachus of Argos and Nile!) and Oceanids; Hyperion sires Helios (Sun) & Selene; Coeus sires Leto (mother of Apollo & Artemis).

nodes.name: Zeus, Hera, Poseidon, Demeter, Hestia & Hades
nodes.role: Elder Olympian Gods (Zeus = PIE Dyaus Pitr!)
nodes.notes: Zeus (exact Proto-Indo-European linguistic cognate of Vedic Sky-Father Dyaus Pitr & Roman Jupiter!) and Poseidon become the divine progenitors of Greece's heroic royal houses.

nodes.name: Atlas (Titan) → Pleiades (Electra & Maia)
nodes.role: Bearer of the Heavens / Ancestor of Troy & Hermes
nodes.notes: Son of Iapetus; father of the Seven Pleiades including Electra (mother of Dardanus, founder of Troy!) and Maia (mother of Hermes).

nodes.name: Prometheus & Epimetheus (+ Pandora)
nodes.notes: Sons of Iapetus. Prometheus molds mortals from clay and water and brings fire from heaven; Epimetheus weds Pandora (first mortal woman) -> Pyrrha!

nodes.name: Deucalion & Pyrrha (Greek Great Flood Survivors)
nodes.notes: Deucalion (son of Prometheus) and Pyrrha (daughter of Epimetheus & Pandora) survive Zeus's world-destroying Flood in a wooden chest/ark (larnax) landing on Mt. Parnassus!

nodes.name: Hellen & Orseis (Eponym of the Greeks / Hellenes)
nodes.role: Progenitor of the Greek Peoples (3 Sons)
nodes.notes: Son of Deucalion & Pyrrha; divides the Greek world among his three sons Dorus, Xuthus, and Aeolus — the Greek 'Table of Nations'!

nodes.name: Dorus (Dorians — Sparta & Peloponnese)
nodes.notes: Eponymous ancestor of the Dorians.

nodes.name: Xuthus & Creusa
nodes.notes: Father of Ion (Ionians) and Achaeus (Achaeans).

nodes.name: Ion (Ionians / Iawones = Biblical Javan!)
nodes.role: Eponym of the Ionians (Exact Cognate of Javan)
nodes.notes: Son of Xuthus (or Apollo) & Creusa; eponym of the Ionians (Archaic Greek Iawones) — EXACT linguistic cognate of Biblical Javan (Yawan, son of Japheth, Gen 10:2)!

nodes.name: Achaeus (Achaeans)
nodes.notes: Eponymous ancestor of the Achaeans (Homer's Greeks).

nodes.name: Aeolus (Aeolians)
nodes.notes: Eponym of the Aeolians; father of Sisyphus, Cretheus, Athamas, Salmoneus, Deion, Magnes, and Perieres.

nodes.name: Sisyphus (King of Corinth → Bellerophon)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; founder of Corinth, grandfather of Pegasus-rider Bellerophon.

nodes.name: Cretheus → Aeson → Jason (Argonauts)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; founder of Iolcus, grandfather of Jason (leader of the Argonauts to Colchis on the Black Sea!).

nodes.name: Salmoneus → Tyro → Pelias & Neleus (→ Nestor)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; ancestor of Neleus and wise King Nestor of Pylos.

nodes.name: Athamas → Phrixus & Helle (Golden Fleece)
nodes.notes: Son of Aeolus; father of Phrixus & Helle (eponym of the Hellespont).

nodes.name: Inachus (Argos) → Phoroneus & Io
nodes.role: First King of Argos & Ancestress of Egypt/Phoenicia/Greece
nodes.notes: Inachus (son of Oceanus) fathers Phoroneus (first mortal king of Argos) and Io, who wanders across the Bosporus into Egypt!

nodes.name: Epaphus (King of Egypt) & Queen Memphis
nodes.role: Son of Zeus & Io / Identified with Egyptian Apis
nodes.notes: Born to Io beside the Nile; becomes King of Egypt, marries Memphis (eponym of Egypt's capital!), and fathers Libya.

nodes.name: Libya (Eponym of North Africa)
nodes.role: Mother of Belus & Agenor (Uniting Africa, Egypt, Phoenicia & Greece!)
nodes.notes: Daughter of Epaphus & Memphis; by Poseidon bears twin sons Belus (Egypt/Babylon/Aethiopia) and Agenor (Tyre/Phoenicia)!

nodes.name: Agenor (King of Tyre / Phoenicia) & Telephassa
nodes.role: Twin Son of Libya & Poseidon / Father of Europa & Cadmus
nodes.notes: Moves from Egypt to Phoenicia (Tyre/Sidon) and fathers Europa, Cadmus, Phoenix, Cilix, and Thasus!

nodes.name: Europa → King Minos of Crete, Rhadamanthus & Sarpedon
nodes.role: Phoenician Princess → Minoan Royal House (Ariadne & Phaedra)
nodes.notes: Carried from Phoenicia to Crete (Biblical Caphtorim!) by Zeus; bears King Minos (lawgiver of Knossos; father of Ariadne & Phaedra), Rhadamanthus, and Sarpedon.

nodes.name: Cadmus (Founder of Thebes) & Harmonia
nodes.role: Bringer of the Phoenician Alphabet to Greece
nodes.notes: Son of Agenor of Tyre; settles in Boeotia, founds Thebes, and introduces the 'Phoenician letters' (alphabet!) to Greece! Fathers Semele (-> Dionysus), Ino, Autonoe, Agave, and Polydorus.

nodes.name: Semele (→ Dionysus) & Polydorus → Laius → Oedipus → Antigone
nodes.notes: Cadmus's daughter Semele bears Dionysus; his son Polydorus leads via Labdacus -> Laius to Oedipus -> Antigone, Eteocles, and Polynices.

nodes.name: Phoenix (Phoenicians) & Cilix (Cilicia)
nodes.notes: Brothers of Cadmus and Europa who settle Phoenicia and Cilicia (SE Anatolia).

nodes.name: Belus (King of Egypt — Ba'al)
nodes.role: Twin Son of Libya & Poseidon / Father of Aegyptus, Danaus & Cepheus
nodes.notes: Reigns in Egypt (name reflects Semitic Ba'al/Bel); fathers Aegyptus, Danaus, Cepheus (King of Aethiopia), and Phineus.

nodes.name: Aegyptus (50 Sons) & Danaus (50 Danaids → Argos)
nodes.role: Eponym of Egypt & Founder of Danaan Argos
nodes.notes: Aegyptus gives his name to Egypt; his twin brother Danaus flees Egypt with his 50 daughters (Danaids) to become King of Argos in Greece (Homer's 'Danaans'!). Daughter Hypermnestra marries Aegyptus's son Lynceus!

nodes.name: Cepheus (King of Aethiopia) & Cassiopeia → Andromeda
nodes.notes: Brother of Danaus & Aegyptus; rules Aethiopia/Joppa coast. Daughter Andromeda is rescued from the sea monster Cetus by Perseus!

nodes.name: Lynceus → Abas → Acrisius → Danaë → Perseus
nodes.role: Slayer of Medusa / Husband of Andromeda
nodes.notes: Descendant of Egyptian Danaus & Aegyptus; slays Medusa, rescues and marries Princess Andromeda of Aethiopia, founds Mycenae, and fathers Perses (mythic eponym of Persia!) and the ancestors of Heracles!

nodes.name: Perses (Son of Perseus & Andromeda)
nodes.role: Greek Mythic Eponym of the Persians!
nodes.notes: Herodotus (VII.61) explicitly records the ancient tradition that the Persians took their name from Perses, son of Perseus and Andromeda — a classic Greek-Iranian genealogical bridge!

nodes.name: Alcaeus / Electryon → Alcmene → Heracles (Hercules)
nodes.role: Greatest Greek Hero / Ancestor of Sparta & Macedon
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Perseus & Andromeda (via Alcmene & Zeus). His sons (Heraclidae: Hyllus, Temenus) become the royal houses of Sparta and Macedon — and 1 Maccabees 12:21 records Sparta claiming kinship with Abraham!

nodes.name: Hyllus → Kings of Sparta (Areus I) & Argead Macedon (Philip II)
nodes.notes: Heraclidae conquer the Peloponnese (Sparta: Leonidas, King Areus I who wrote to Jerusalem's High Priest claiming descent from Abraham!) and Temenus's line founds Macedon (Perdiccas I -> Philip II).

nodes.name: Alexander the Great (Macedon → Persia, Egypt & India)
nodes.role: Conqueror Uniting Greece, Egypt, Mesopotamia, Persia & NW India
nodes.notes: Son of Philip II (Heraclid) and Olympias (claiming descent from Achilles!). Conquers Darius III of Persia, is crowned Pharaoh in Egypt, and marches to the Indus — even woven into the Persian Shahnameh as 'Eskandar' (half-brother of Dara)!

nodes.name: Tantalus (Lydia) → Pelops → Atreus & Thyestes
nodes.notes: Tantalus of Anatolia/Lydia fathers Pelops (eponym of the Peloponnese!), who fathers Atreus and Thyestes.

nodes.name: Agamemnon (→ Orestes) & Menelaus (+ Helen of Sparta)
nodes.role: Kings of Mycenae & Sparta (Sons of Atreus)
nodes.notes: Agamemnon leads the Achaeans against Troy (father of Orestes, Electra, Iphigenia); Menelaus weds Helen (daughter of Zeus & Leda, sister of Castor, Pollux & Clytemnestra).

nodes.name: Peleus → Achilles & Laertes → Odysseus (→ Telemachus)
nodes.notes: Achilles (son of Peleus & Thetis, grandson of Aeacus; father of Neoptolemus — claimed ancestor of Alexander's mother Olympias!) and Odysseus (King of Ithaca, father of Telemachus).

nodes.name: Dardanus (son of Zeus & Electra) → Erichthonius → Tros
nodes.notes: Dardanus (son of Zeus & Atlas's daughter Electra) founds Dardania near the Hellespont; grandson Tros gives his name to Troy and fathers Ilus, Assaracus, and Ganymede!

nodes.name: Ilus → Laomedon → King Priam → Hector, Paris & Cassandra
nodes.notes: Senior branch of Troy: Ilus -> Laomedon -> King Priam & Queen Hecuba, parents of Hector, Paris (Alexander), Cassandra, Helenus, and Creusa (first wife of Aeneas).

nodes.name: Assaracus → Capys → Anchises → Aeneas (+ Lavinia)
nodes.era: Fall of Troy → Migration to Italy (Aeneid)
nodes.notes: Junior Trojan branch: Assaracus -> Capys -> Anchises (+ Aphrodite) -> Aeneas, who escapes burning Troy to Italy (Latium), marries Lavinia (daughter of King Latinus), and fathers Ascanius (Iulus) and Silvius!

nodes.name: Ascanius (Iulus) → Alba Longa Kings → Rhea Silvia → Romulus & Remus
nodes.notes: Ascanius (Iulus, ancestor of the Julian clan / Julius Caesar!) & Silvius found Alba Longa -> 12 Alban kings -> Numitor -> Rhea Silvia (+ Mars) -> twin founders Romulus & Remus! Directly intersects Book of Jasher's Kittim/Zepho/Janeus chronicle of early Italy!

nodes.name: Ethbaal of Tyre → Mattan I → Queen Dido (Elissa of Carthage)
nodes.role: Phoenician Founder of Carthage (Great-Niece of Jezebel!)
nodes.notes: Tyrian royal records (Menander of Ephesus, quoted by Josephus) trace King Ethbaal (Ithobaal I of Sidon/Tyre, father of Biblical Jezebel!) -> Baal-Eser II -> Mattan I -> Pygmalion & Queen Elissa (Dido), who sails from Tyre to North Africa and founds Carthage!

nodes.name: Atys of Lydia → Lydus (Lydians) & Tyrrhenus (Etruscans)
nodes.notes: Herodotus records that during an 18-year famine in Lydia (Biblical Lud, Gen 10:22!), King Atys split his people between Lydus (staying in Anatolia) and Tyrrhenus, who sailed to Italy to found the Etruscans (Tyrsenians — widely linked by scholars to Biblical Tiras, Gen 10:2)!

nodes.name: Gens Julia → Julius Caesar & Emperor Augustus (Rome)
nodes.role: Roman Imperial Claimants of Trojan Descent via Aeneas/Iulus
nodes.notes: Julius Caesar publicly claimed descent from Aeneas's son Iulus (Ascanius) and goddess Venus/Aphrodite; his adopted heir Augustus commissioned Virgil's Aeneid to immortalize Rome's Trojan genealogy!

nodes.name: Pangu (Cosmic Creator)
nodes.notes: Emerges from the cosmic egg, separates Yin (Earth) and Yang (Heaven), and transforms his body into mountains, rivers, sun, and moon.

nodes.name: Fuxi & Nüwa (Three Sovereigns)
nodes.notes: Serpent-tailed sovereigns holding compass and square. Fuxi invents the Eight Trigrams (Bagua), fishing nets, and music; Nüwa repairs the shattered sky after Gonggong's flood and molds humanity from yellow clay. Preserved in SW Chinese Miao/Yao lore as Great Flood survivors!

nodes.name: Shaodian & Youqiao (Guoyu)
nodes.notes: Guoyu explicitly records Shaodian and Lady Youqiao as parents of BOTH Yandi (Jiang surname) and Huangdi (Ji surname) — explaining the ancestral brotherhood of 'Yan-Huang Zisun'!

nodes.name: Yandi (Flame Emperor / Shennong)
nodes.notes: Inventor of agriculture, plows, and herbal medicine; ancestor of the Jiang clan (later Jiang Ziya & the State of Qi!). Allies with Huangdi after the Battle of Banquan to defeat Chiyou.

nodes.name: Chiyou (Jiuli Tribe) & Jiang Ziya (State of Qi)
nodes.notes: Chiyou (legendary bronze-working leader of the Nine Li / Miao-Hmong ancestor!) fought Huangdi at Zhuolu; Jiang Ziya (descendant of Yandi's clan) helped King Wu found the Zhou Dynasty and became Duke of Qi.

nodes.name: Huangdi (Yellow Emperor) & Leizu
nodes.role: Universal Royal Ancestor in Sima Qian's Shiji (25 Sons)
nodes.notes: Marries Leizu (inventor of silk sericulture) and sires 25 sons bearing 14 surnames. Sima Qian systematically traces ALL Five Emperors, Xia, Shang, Zhou, Qin, Chu, Confucius, and the Xiongnu back to Huangdi!

nodes.name: Shaohao (Xuanxiao) → Jiaoji
nodes.notes: Son of Huangdi & Leizu; ancestor of Eastern Yi bird-totem clans and father of Jiaoji -> Emperor Ku.

nodes.name: Emperor Ku (Di Ku / Gaoxin)
nodes.role: Great-Grandson of Huangdi / Father of Yao, Shang & Zhou
nodes.notes: By his four consorts, Di Ku fathers Emperor Zhi, Emperor Yao (via Qingdu), Xie (founder of Shang via Jiandi), and Hou Ji (founder of Zhou via Jiang Yuan)!

nodes.name: Emperor Yao (Tang Yao → Liu Bang / Han Dynasty)
nodes.notes: Son of Di Ku & Qingdu; appoints Gun & Yu to combat the Great Flood, marries his daughters Ehuang & Nüying to Emperor Shun, and passes the throne by merit. Han Dynasty emperors (Liu Bang) claimed descent from Yao!

nodes.name: Xie (son of Di Ku & Jiandi) → Wang Hai
nodes.role: Progenitor of the Shang Royal House (Zi Clan)
nodes.notes: Conceived when Jiandi swallowed a black bird's egg; assisted Yu the Great with the Flood; leads through 14 predynastic lords (including Wang Hai) to Tang of Shang.

nodes.name: Tang of Shang (Cheng Tang) → Pan Geng
nodes.role: Founder of Shang Dynasty & Mover of Capital to Anyang
nodes.notes: Overthrew Xia tyrant Jie to found the Shang Dynasty; 19th king Pan Geng moved the capital to Yin (Anyang), where tens of thousands of oracle bones confirm Sima Qian's king list!

nodes.name: King Wu Ding & Warrior Queen Fu Hao
nodes.role: First Historically Verified Shang Monarch & Female General
nodes.notes: 21st Shang king attested in contemporary oracle bones; his consort Fu Hao served as supreme general and high priestess (her intact tomb at Anyang is one of archaeology's greatest treasures!).

nodes.name: Di Xin (King Zhou of Shang) — Final Shang King
nodes.role: Last King of Shang (Battle of Muye)
nodes.notes: Defeated by King Wu of Zhou in 1046 BCE, ending the Shang Dynasty.

nodes.name: Weizi Qi (Duke of Song) → Kong He → Confucius (Kong Qiu)
nodes.role: Shang Royal Descendant & China's Great Sage
nodes.notes: Sima Qian's Shiji Ch. 47 traces Confucius (Kong Qiu) directly back through the Dukes of Song to Weizi Qi (brother of Di Xin) -> Shang Dynasty -> Xie -> Di Ku -> Yellow Emperor!

nodes.name: Jizi (Gija — Shang Prince Migrating to Korea)
nodes.role: Shang Royal Sage & China-Korea Chronicle Bridge
nodes.notes: Uncle/kinsman of Shang king Di Xin; recorded in both Chinese (*Shiji*) and Korean (*Samguk Yusa*) chronicles as migrating east to Joseon with 5,000 followers after the fall of Shang!

nodes.name: Hou Ji (Lord Millet) → Gong Liu → Gugong Danfu
nodes.role: Minister of Agriculture & Progenitor of Zhou
nodes.notes: Son of Di Ku & Jiang Yuan; taught millet farming and founded the Ji lineage leading via Buzhu -> Gong Liu -> Gugong Danfu (whose elder sons Taibo & Zhongyong founded the State of Wu!).

nodes.name: King Wen (Ji Chang) → King Wu (Ji Fa) of Zhou
nodes.role: Founders of the Zhou Dynasty & Mandate of Heaven
nodes.notes: King Wen expanded the Yijing (Book of Changes); his son King Wu allied with Jiang Ziya to defeat Shang at Muye (1046 BCE), establishing China's longest dynasty (800 years!).

nodes.name: Duke of Zhou (Ji Dan — Founder of Lu) & King Mu of Zhou
nodes.role: Architect of Zhou Rites & Western Silk-Road Traveler
nodes.notes: Duke of Zhou (brother of King Wu) founded the State of Lu (homeland of Confucius!) and codified classical ritual; 5th king King Mu journeyed far west into Central Asia to meet Xiwangmu (Queen Mother of the West)!

nodes.name: Changyi → Emperor Zhuanxu (Gaoyang)
nodes.role: Separator of Heaven & Earth / Ancestor of Xia, Shun, Qin & Chu
nodes.notes: Grandson of Huangdi via Changyi; ordered the separation of Heaven and Earth (Jue Di Tian Tong). Progenitor of FOUR huge dynasties: Xia, Shun/Chen, Qin, and Chu!

nodes.name: Gun (Father of Yu the Great)
nodes.era: Great Flood Era (Shangshu / Shan Hai Jing)
nodes.role: Descendant of Zhuanxu Who Stole Xirang Soil
nodes.notes: Descendant of Zhuanxu tasked by Emperor Yao with halting the Great Flood; stole the heavenly self-expanding earth (Xirang) to build dikes, was executed on Feather Mountain, and from his body emerged Yu the Great!

nodes.name: Yu the Great (Da Yu) & Tushan Shi → Qi (Xia Dynasty)
nodes.role: Tamer of the Great Flood & Founder of Xia Dynasty
nodes.notes: Spent 13 years dredging channels to drain the Gun-Yu Great Flood into the sea, mapping the Nine Provinces; his son Qi established China's first hereditary dynasty (Xia)!

nodes.name: Tai Kang → Shao Kang (Xia Restoration) → King Jie & State of Yue
nodes.role: Xia Successors & Ancestors of Yue (King Goujian)
nodes.notes: Shao Kang restored the Xia Dynasty after Hou Yi's usurpation; his son Wuyu founded the southern State of Yue (later led by King Goujian); Xia ended under tyrant Jie.

nodes.name: Gusou → Emperor Shun (Youyu) & Ehuang / Nüying
nodes.notes: Descended from Zhuanxu via Qiongchan -> Jingkang -> Juwang -> Qiaoniu -> Gusou; married Yao's two daughters Ehuang & Nüying and passed the throne to Yu the Great. Ancestor of the State of Chen!

nodes.name: Nüxiu → Daye → Boyi → Feizi → Qin Shi Huang (First Emperor)
nodes.role: House of Ying (Descendants of Zhuanxu → Unified China!)
nodes.notes: Sima Qian's Shiji Ch. 5 traces the Ying clan from Zhuanxu's granddaughter Nüxiu -> Daye -> Boyi (Yu the Great's companion!) -> Feizi -> Dukes of Qin -> Ying Zheng (**Qin Shi Huang**, First Emperor of unified China, 221 BCE)!

nodes.name: Zhurong → Luzhong (Pengzu, 800 yrs!) → Jilian → State of Chu (Qu Yuan)
nodes.role: House of Mi / Southern Chu Dynasty (Descendant of Zhuanxu)
nodes.notes: Shiji Ch. 40 traces the southern Chu royal house from Zhuanxu -> Zhurong (Fire deity!) -> Wuhui -> Luzhong (father of 6 sons including 800-year longevity sage Pengzu and Jilian!) -> Xiong Yi -> poet Qu Yuan & Hegemon Xiang Yu!

nodes.name: Chunwei (Xia Prince) → Touman → Modu Chanyu (Xiongnu)
nodes.role: Sima Qian's Bridge Between Chinese Xia & Inner Asian Steppe
sources: Sima Qian Shiji Ch. 110 (Account of the Xiongnu)
nodes.notes: Sima Qian explicitly records that the Xiongnu descended from Chunwei, a prince of the Xia Dynasty who migrated to the northern steppes; unified under Touman -> Modu Chanyu (209 BCE)!

nodes.name: Turk (Oljai Khan) → Tatar & Mongol → Oghuz Khagan
nodes.role: Eponymous Ancestor of Turkic & Mongol Peoples
nodes.notes: Rashid al-Din & Abulghazi explicitly graft Turkic/Mongol ancestry onto Biblical Japheth (Yafith -> Oljai -> Alinja -> Tatar & Mongol -> Kara Khan -> Oghuz Khagan) and Iranian Turan!

nodes.name: 6 Sons of Oghuz: Gün (Sun), Ay (Moon), Yildiz, Gök, Dağ & Deniz
nodes.role: Founders of the 24 Oghuz Turkic Tribes (Seljuks & Ottomans!)
nodes.notes: Oghuz's 3 elder sons (Bozok: Gün, Ay, Yildiz) and 3 younger sons (Üçok: Gök, Dağ, Deniz) each sire 4 sons = the 24 Oghuz clans (including Kayı -> Ottomans and Kınık -> Seljuks!).

nodes.name: Hwanin (Lord of Heaven) → Hwanung & Ungnyeo
sources: Samguk Yusa (1281 CE, citing lost Gogi)
nodes.notes: Hwanung descends from Heaven to Mt. Taebaek with 3,000 followers and the gods of Wind, Rain, and Clouds; weds Ungnyeo (the bear who endured 100 days of mugwort and garlic to become human).

nodes.name: Dangun Wanggeom (Founder of Gojoseon, 2333 BCE trad.) → Buru
nodes.role: Founding Ancestor of the Korean People
nodes.notes: Son of Hwanung & Ungnyeo; founded Gojoseon (Asadal) in the traditional era of Chinese Emperor Yao! Father of Prince Buru (who in Korean annals meets Yu the Great at Tushan!).

nodes.name: Hae Mosu + Yuhwa → King Dongmyeong (Jumong — Goguryeo)
nodes.notes: Born from a luminous egg to Yuhwa (daughter of River God Habaek) and heavenly prince Hae Mosu; founded the northern kingdom of Goguryeo (leading to King Yuri and King Gwanggaeto the Great!).

nodes.name: Soseono → Onjo (Founder of Baekje) → King Geunchogo
nodes.role: Founder of Baekje & Royal Bridge to Yamato Japan!
nodes.notes: Onjo (son of Jumong & Lady Soseono) founded Baekje in SW Korea; Baekje became Yamato Japan's closest ally, transmitting Chinese writing (Wani), Buddhism, and royal intermarriage (Emperor Kammu's mother descended from Baekje's King Muryeong!)!

nodes.name: Park Hyeokgeose (+ Aryeong), Seok Talhae & Kim Alji (Silla)
nodes.role: Founding Clans of Silla (Park, Seok & Kim)
nodes.notes: Park Hyeokgeose (born from a luminous egg at Najeong well) founded Silla; joined by Seok Talhae and Kim Alji (born from a golden box in Gyerim forest — ancestor of Queen Seondeok & unified Silla kings!).

nodes.name: King Suro of Gaya + Queen Heo Hwang-ok (Princess of Ayuta / India!)
nodes.role: India ↔ Korea Royal Marriage Bridge (Gimhae Kim & Heo Clans)
nodes.notes: King Suro (born from one of 6 golden eggs on Mt. Guji) married Princess Heo Hwang-ok (Suriratna), who sailed to Korea from the Kingdom of Ayuta (traditionally identified with Ayodhya, India — capital of the Solar Dynasty!) carrying a stone pagoda. Ancestors of millions of Gimhae Kim & Heo Koreans!

nodes.name: Ame-no-Minakanushi, Takamimusubi & Kamimusubi
nodes.notes: Three primordial creation deities appearing at the dawn of Heaven and Earth; Takamimusubi is the maternal grandfather of Ninigi!

nodes.name: Izanagi & Izanami (Creators of the Japanese Islands)
nodes.notes: Stir the primeval ocean with the heavenly jeweled spear Amenonuhoko to birth Onogoro and the Eight Great Islands of Japan, plus Fire God Kagutsuchi and the Three Noble Children.

nodes.name: Amaterasu-Omikami (Sun Goddess) & Tsukuyomi (Moon)
nodes.role: Supreme Sun Goddess / Ancestress of Japan's Emperors
nodes.notes: Born from Izanagi's left eye upon purifying himself from Yomi (the Underworld); ruler of the High Plain of Heaven (Takamagahara) and divine ancestress of the Imperial House of Japan.

nodes.name: Susanoo-no-Mikoto (+ Kushinadahime) → Okuninushi (Izumo)
nodes.notes: Brother of Amaterasu; slays the eight-headed serpent Yamata-no-Orochi to win the Kusanagi sword, marries Kushinadahime, and sires the Izumo dynasty leading to Okuninushi (who builds Izumo and cedes the land to Amaterasu's grandson Ninigi!).

nodes.name: Ame-no-Oshihomimi & Ninigi-no-Mikoto (+ Konohanasakuya-hime)
nodes.role: Grandson of Amaterasu Bearing the Three Imperial Regalia
nodes.notes: Amaterasu's son Ame-no-Oshihomimi weds Takamimusubi's daughter and sires Ninigi, who descends to Mt. Takachiho (Kyushu) carrying the Mirror, Jewel, and Sword (Three Imperial Regalia) and marries Mt. Fuji goddess Konohanasakuya-hime!

nodes.name: Hoderi & Hoori (+ Toyotama-hime) → Ugayafukiaezu
nodes.notes: Hoori (Yamasachihiko) journeys to the underwater palace of Sea God Ryujin/Watatsumi, weds sea princess Toyotama-hime, and fathers Ugayafukiaezu -> Emperor Jimmu!

nodes.name: Emperor Jimmu (Kamu-yamato Iware-biko, 1st Emperor)
nodes.role: Founder of the Imperial House of Japan (Yamato)
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Ninigi; leads the Eastern Expedition from Kyushu to Yamato (Nara), guided by the three-legged crow Yatagarasu, founding the world's oldest continuous hereditary monarchy!

nodes.name: Emperor Sujin (10th) → Emperor Keiko → Prince Yamato Takeru
nodes.role: First Historical Yamato Anchor & Heroic Prince
nodes.notes: Emperor Sujin is widely regarded as the earliest historically grounded Yamato ruler; his descendant Prince Yamato Takeru wields Susanoo's Kusanagi sword to unify Honshu.

nodes.name: Empress Jingu → Emperor Ojin (Hachiman) → Emperor Nintoku → Prince Shotoku
nodes.role: Yamato Emperors & Architects of Korean/Chinese Cultural Bridge
nodes.notes: Emperor Ojin (deified as Hachiman) welcomed Baekje Korean scholar Wani (bringing Chinese characters and Confucius's Analects to Japan!); Prince Shotoku (574-622 CE) established Buddhism and Japan's 17-Article Constitution!

nodes.name: Ymir & Auðumbla → Búri → Borr & Bestla
nodes.role: Primordial Frost Giant & Ancestors of the Aesir
nodes.notes: From ice and fire in Ginnungagap emerge giant Ymir and cosmic cow Auðumbla, who licks Búri from salty ice -> Borr (+ giantess Bestla) -> Odin, Vili, and Vé! Note: Bergelmir survives the blood-deluge of Ymir in a wooden boat/box (Norse Flood motif!).

nodes.name: Odin, Vili & Vé → Ask & Embla (First Humans)
nodes.role: Creators of Midgard & First Mortal Couple
nodes.notes: Odin, Vili, and Vé shape the world from Ymir and breathe spirit, mind, and warmth into two shoreline trees (Ash & Elm) to create Ask & Embla, progenitors of humanity!

nodes.name: Thor, Baldr (→ Forseti), Týr (= Zeus/Dyaus!) & Víðarr
nodes.role: Sons of Odin & Proto-Indo-European Sky-God Týr
nodes.notes: Odin's sons include Thor (Thunder), Baldr, and Víðarr; Týr (*Tiwaz) is the EXACT Proto-Indo-European linguistic cognate of Vedic Dyaus Pitr and Greek Zeus Pater!

nodes.name: Snorri's Euhemeristic Bridge: Priam → Tror (Thor) → Voden (Odin)
nodes.role: Medieval Norse Chronicle Linking Troy & Aethiopia to Scandinavia!
nodes.notes: In his Prose Edda Prologue, Snorri Sturluson explicitly derives the Norse Aesir ('Men of Asia') from King Priam of Troy -> daughter Troan (+ King Munon/Memnon!) -> Tror (Thor) -> 18 generations -> Voden (Odin), who migrates north from Troy/Asia to Sweden and Denmark!

nodes.name: Yngvi-Freyr (Ynglings → Harald Fairhair) & Skjöldr (Scyld → Beowulf)
nodes.role: Founders of Swedish, Norwegian & Danish Dynasties
nodes.notes: Odin's lines produce Skjöldr (Scyld Scefing of Beowulf, ancestor of Danish kings), Yngvi-Freyr (Vanir son of Njörðr -> Swedish & Norwegian Yngling kings -> Harald Fairhair!), and Sigi -> Volsung -> Sigmund -> Sigurd the Dragon-Slayer!

nodes.name: Tuisto → Mannus (= Vedic Manu!) → Ingaevones, Herminones & Istaevones
nodes.role: Germanic Table of Nations & PIE Cognate of Manu!
nodes.notes: Roman historian Tacitus records ancient Germanic origin songs tracing all Germanic peoples to Earth-born Tuisto -> Mannus (EXACT Proto-Indo-European cognate of Vedic Manu!) -> three sons founding the Ingaevones (North Sea), Herminones (Central), and Istaevones (Rhine/Franks)!

nodes.name: Fénius Farsaid (Scythian Inventor of Gaelic at Babel) → Nel
nodes.era: Lebor Gabála Érenn (Irish Book of Invasions)
nodes.role: Descendant of Japheth/Magog & Linguistic Sage at Babel
nodes.notes: Medieval Irish chronicles trace Gaelic ancestry from Noah -> Japheth -> Magog -> Baath -> Fénius Farsaid, a Scythian king who creates the Gaelic language and Ogham script from the 72 tongues at the Tower of Babel! Father of Nel.

nodes.name: Nel + Princess Scota (Daughter of Pharaoh!) → Goídel Glas (Gaels)
nodes.role: Irish-Egyptian Chronicle Bridge (Eponym of Gaels & Scots!)
nodes.notes: Nel journeys to Egypt, befriends Moses during the Exodus, and marries Princess Scota (daughter of Pharaoh Cingris!). Their son Goídel Glas gives his name to the Gaels (Goidelic Irish & Scottish), while Scota gives her name to Scotland!

nodes.name: Breogán (Spain) → Míl Espáine → Éber Finn, Éremón & Amairgin (Milesians)
nodes.role: Ancestors of the Gaelic Irish & Scottish High Kings
nodes.notes: Descended from Goídel Glas -> Sru -> Éber Scot -> Breogán (builder of the Tower of Brigantia in Galicia, Spain) -> Míl Espáine! His sons Éber Finn, Éremón, and poet-druid Amairgin sail from Spain to Ireland and defeat the Tuatha Dé Danann.

nodes.name: Cessair, Partholón, Nemed & Tuatha Dé Danann (Danu, Dagda, Lugh, Brigid)
nodes.notes: Begins with Noah's granddaughter Cessair arriving in Ireland before the Flood, followed by Partholón, Nemed, Fir Bolg, and the divine Tuatha Dé Danann (Danu, The Dagda, Nuada, Brigid, and sun-hero Lugh -> father of Cú Chulainn!).

nodes.name: Niall of the Nine Hostages (Uí Néill) & Fergus Mór → Kenneth MacAlpin
nodes.role: Irish High Kings & 1st King of Scots
nodes.notes: Milesian royal lines produce Niall of the Nine Hostages (ancestor of the Uí Néill High Kings of Ireland) and Fergus Mór of Dál Riata -> Kenneth MacAlpin (Cináed mac Ailpín, unifier of Picts & Scots, 843 CE!).

nodes.name: Brutus of Troy → Locrinus (England), Camber (Wales) & Albanactus (Scotland)
nodes.era: Historia Brittonum (9th c.) & Geoffrey of Monmouth
nodes.role: Trojan Eponym of Britain & Tripartite Division of the Island
nodes.notes: Great-grandson of Trojan prince Aeneas (via Ascanius -> Silvius -> Brutus); leads Trojan exiles to Albion, renames it Britain, founds Troia Nova (London), and divides the island among his 3 sons: Locrinus, Camber, and Albanactus!

nodes.name: King Lear (Leir) → Beli Mawr → Uther Pendragon → King Arthur
nodes.notes: Continuation of Brutus's British chronicle through King Leir (Shakespeare's Lear), Welsh ancestor Beli Mawr, Cassivellaunus, and Uther Pendragon to King Arthur of Camelot.

nodes.name: Perun & Veles / Lech (Poland), Czech (Bohemia) & Rus (Rus')
nodes.era: Slavic Origin Chronicles (Primary Chronicle / Great Poland Chronicle)
nodes.notes: The Slavic tripartite origin legend traces Poland (Lech), Bohemia/Czechia (Czech), and Rus' (Rus) to three brothers; the Russian Primary Chronicle explicitly assigns all Slavic peoples to Japheth's portion of Earth!

nodes.name: Tepeu, Gucumatz (Feathered Serpent) & Huracán (Heart of Sky)
nodes.notes: Create Earth from primordial waters, test clay and wood humans (destroyed by a Great Flood of resin and water!), and prepare the dawn for maize humanity.

nodes.name: Xpiyacoc & Xmucane → Hun Hunahpu (+ Xquic) → Hero Twins (Hunahpu & Xbalanque)
nodes.role: Defeaters of Xibalba / Sun & Moon Twins
nodes.notes: Grandmother Xmucane's sons Hun Hunahpu & Vucub Hunahpu are slain in Xibalba; Blood Moon maiden Xquic bears the Hero Twins Hunahpu & Xbalanque, who conquer the Underworld Lords and ascend as Sun and Moon!

nodes.name: Four Maize Ancestors: Balam-Quitzé, Balam-Acab, Mahucutah & Iqui-Balam
nodes.era: Creation of True Humanity (Popol Vuh Part 3)
nodes.role: First Four Maya Progenitors & Their 4 Wives
nodes.notes: Shaped from yellow and white maize by the creators alongside their 4 wives (Caha-Paluna, Chomiha, Tzununiha, Caquixaha); migrate from Tulan Zuyua to found the K'iche' & Kaqchikel Maya nations (and parallel Classic Maya dynasties like K'inich Janaab Pakal of Palenque!).

nodes.name: Ometeotl → Quetzalcoatl, Tezcatlipoca, Xipe Totec & Huitzilopochtli
nodes.role: Lord of Duality & Four Creator Brothers
sources: Historia de los Mexicanos por sus Pinturas
nodes.notes: Dual supreme creator Ometecuhtli & Omecihuatl births the four cosmic directions/brothers governing the Five Suns of Mesoamerica.

nodes.name: Tata & Nene (Fourth Sun Flood) → Quetzalcoatl Recreates Fifth Sun Humanity
nodes.role: Aztec Great Flood Survivors & Fifth Sun Creation
nodes.notes: Warned by Tezcatlipoca/Titlacahuan of the Great Flood ending the Fourth Sun (Water Sun), Tata & Nene survive inside a hollowed cypress log! Afterwards Quetzalcoatl journeys to Mictlan to retrieve ancestral bones and sprinkle his own blood to create Fifth Sun humanity!

nodes.name: Aztlán / Chicomoztoc → Acamapichtli → Moctezuma I → Moctezuma II
nodes.role: Seven Caves Migration & Tlatoque of Tenochtitlan
nodes.notes: Guided by Huitzilopochtli from Aztlán & the Seven Caves (Chicomoztoc) to Tenochtitlan (1325 CE); 1st Tlatoani Acamapichtli unites Mexica kingship with the sacred Toltec lineage of Ce Acatl Topiltzin Quetzalcoatl, leading to Itzcoatl, Moctezuma I, Moctezuma II, and Cuauhtémoc!

nodes.name: Viracocha (Uno Pachacuti Flood) → Inti (Sun) & Mama Quilla (Moon)
nodes.role: Creator of Andean Nations from Clay & Flood Deity
sources: Garcilaso de la Vega Comentarios Reales
nodes.notes: Viracocha emerges from Lake Titicaca, wipes away unruly stone giants in the Uno Pachacuti (Great Flood!), and shapes each Andean nation from painted clay at Tiwanaku before walking west across the Pacific Ocean!

nodes.name: Manco Cápac & Mama Ocllo (Four Ayar Brothers → Founders of Cusco)
nodes.role: Children of the Sun / First Sapa Inca
nodes.notes: Sent by Sun God Inti from Lake Titicaca (or Pacariqtambo with the Four Ayar Brothers) with a golden staff that sinks into fertile earth at Cusco, founding the Inca Dynasty!

nodes.name: Sinchi Roca → Pachacuti (Machu Picchu) → Tupac Inca → Huayna Capac → Atahualpa
nodes.notes: 9th Sapa Inca Pachacuti ('Earth-Shaker') transforms Cusco into the vast Tawantinsuyu empire and builds Machu Picchu; his son Tupac Inca Yupanqui even records a legendary Pacific balsa-raft voyage westward, followed by Huayna Capac -> Huáscar & Atahualpa!

nodes.name: Sky Woman (Atahensic) → Twin Brothers → Hiawatha & The Great Peacemaker
nodes.role: Turtle Island Origin & Five Nations Confederacy
nodes.notes: Sky Woman falls from Sky World onto the back of Great Turtle (Turtle Island), birthing the cosmic twins (Sapling & Flint); centuries later The Great Peacemaker (Deganawida), Jigonsaseh, and Hiawatha unite the Five Nations Confederacy!

nodes.name: First Man & First Woman / Changing Woman (Diné) & White Buffalo Calf Woman (Lakota)
nodes.notes: Diné tradition traces humanity through Four Worlds with First Man, First Woman, and Changing Woman (mother of Hero Twins Monster Slayer & Born for Water); Lakota tradition centers on White Buffalo Calf Woman uniting the Seven Council Fires (Oceti Sakowin).

nodes.name: Te Kore / Te Pō → Ranginui (Sky Father) & Papatūānuku (Earth Mother)
nodes.notes: Ranginui (Sky) and Papatūānuku (Earth) hold each other in darkness until their son Tāne-mahuta pushes them apart to let light into the world — striking universal parallel to Greek Gaia/Uranus, Vedic Dyaus/Prithvi, and Chinese Pangu!

nodes.name: Tāne-mahuta (+ Hine-ahu-one from Clay!), Tangaroa & Tūmatauenga
nodes.role: Creator of First Mortal Woman from Clay & Ocean God
nodes.notes: Tāne-mahuta shapes the first mortal woman Hine-ahu-one from red clay at Kurawaka and breathes life into her nostrils (tihei mauri ora!), while Tangaroa (Tagaloa) rules the Pacific Ocean and Tūmatauenga represents humanity!

nodes.name: Māui (Māui-tikitiki-a-Taranga — Pan-Polynesian Hero)
nodes.role: Fisher of Islands, Snarer of the Sun & Fire-Bringer
sources: Māori, Hawaiian, Tahitian, Samoan & Tongan Oral Epics
nodes.notes: Shared across every corner of the Polynesian Triangle (Hawaii to Aotearoa/New Zealand to Rapa Nui): fishes up islands from the sea, slows the Sun, and brings fire from Mahuika — uniting Polynesia's oral genealogies!

nodes.name: Wākea & Papahānaumoku → Hoʻohōkūkalani → Hāloa → King Kamehameha I
nodes.role: Ancestral Lineage of All Native Hawaiians & Hawaiian Monarchy
nodes.notes: The sacred Kumulipo traces cosmic evolution from coral polyp through Sky Father Wākea & Earth Mother Papa to Hāloa (first taro plant & first human ancestor of the Hawaiian people!), continuing down through Pāʻao and Umi-a-Līloa to King Kamehameha I (unifier of Hawaii, 1810)!

nodes.name: Hawaiki → Kupe (Aotearoa), ʻAhoʻeitu (Tuʻi Tonga) & Hotu Matuʻa (Rapa Nui)
nodes.role: Master Navigators of Aotearoa, Tonga & Easter Island
nodes.notes: Documents the greatest open-ocean ancestral voyaging in human history: Kupe & the Great Fleet waka settling Aotearoa (New Zealand), ʻAhoʻeitu founding the Tuʻi Tonga Empire (c. 950 CE, son of sky god Tangaloa!), and Ariki Hotu Matuʻa settling Rapa Nui (Easter Island)!

nodes.name: Mitochondrial Eve (mtDNA L0–L3, ~150–200 kya, Africa)
nodes.role: Most Recent Common Matrilineal Ancestor of All Living Humans
nodes.notes: Every living human carries mitochondrial DNA descended from African matrilineal root L (splitting into L0, L1, L2 across Sub-Saharan Africa and L3 in East Africa, source of the Out-of-Africa expansion ~70 kya).

nodes.name: Y-Chromosomal Adam (Y-DNA A00 / A–BT, ~200–300 kya, Africa)
nodes.role: Most Recent Common Patrilineal Ancestor of All Living Men
nodes.notes: Deepest patrilineal root of humanity (A00 discovered in Cameroon/Central-West Africa; A & B across Southern/East Africa; BT -> CT giving rise to ALL non-African and most African Y-DNA lineages).

nodes.name: Out-of-Africa Dispersal (mtDNA M & N / Y-DNA CT → CF & DE, ~70–55 kya)
nodes.role: Shared Ancestral Bottleneck of All Eurasian, Oceanic & American Peoples
nodes.notes: Small ancestral groups crossed from East Africa via the Bab-el-Mandeb / Sinai corridor carrying mtDNA L3 (-> M, N, R) and Y-DNA CT (-> DE, CF), later encountering Neanderthals (~55 kya) and Denisovans (~45 kya) in Eurasia!

nodes.name: Y-DNA E1b1a (E-V38 — West, Central & Bantu African Expansion)
nodes.role: Primary Patrilineal Corridor of Niger-Congo & Bantu Peoples
nodes.notes: Dominant paternal haplogroup across West, Central, East, and Southern Africa — bridging Yoruba, Benin, Mande/Mali, and Bantu Great Lakes populations!

nodes.name: Y-DNA E1b1b (E-M215 — Horn of Africa, Egypt, Amazigh & Levant)
nodes.notes: Unites the Horn of Africa (Ethiopia/Kush), Ancient Egypt (attested in Ramesses III!), North African Amazigh/Berbers (E-M81), and Natufian Levantines!

nodes.name: Y-DNA J1 (J-M267) & J2 (J-M172) — Fertile Crescent, Semitic & Mediterranean
nodes.notes: J1 expanded across the Arabian Peninsula, Levant, and Mesopotamia (highly enriched in Jewish, Arab, and Assyrian populations — including the Cohen Modal Haplotype!); J2 expanded from the Zagros/Anatolia across Phoenicia, Minoan Crete, Greece, and Etruscan Italy!

nodes.name: Y-DNA G2a — Anatolian Neolithic Farmers (Spread of Agriculture)
nodes.notes: Carried by early Neolithic farmers (including Ötzi the Iceman!) from Anatolia and the Caucasus across the Mediterranean and Central Europe.

nodes.name: Y-DNA R1b (Yamnaya Steppe → Western Europe, Celtic & Italic)
nodes.role: Bronze Age Steppe Expansion into Western Europe
nodes.notes: Expanded dramatically from Pontic-Caspian Steppe Yamnaya/Bell Beaker pastoralists into Central Europe, Italy, Iberia, Britain, and Ireland (accounting for ~80%+ of modern Irish/Celtic paternal lineages!).

nodes.name: Y-DNA R1a (Corded Ware / Sintashta → Indo-Iranian & Slavic)
nodes.notes: Sintashta/Andronovo chariot pastoralists carrying R1a-Z93 expanded southward across Central Asia into the Iranian Plateau and Northern India (~2000–1500 BCE), directly mirroring the shared Vedic-Avestan linguistic & genealogical layer!

nodes.name: Y-DNA I1 & I2 — Paleolithic European & Nordic Corridor
nodes.notes: Ancient pre-Neolithic European haplogroup (sister clade of Near Eastern J via IJ!) that surged across Scandinavia and the Balkans.

nodes.name: Y-DNA H & L — Ancient Indus Valley (Harappan) & South Asian Roots
nodes.role: Indus Valley Civilization & Ancient South Asian Ancestral Layer
nodes.notes: Indus Valley Civilization (Harappa/Rakhigarhi) combined Iranian-plateau farmer ancestry with indigenous South Asian hunter-gatherers (AASI), later admixing with Steppe R1a pastoralists to form modern South Asia!

nodes.name: Y-DNA O2 (O-M122) — Yellow River Neolithic (Sino-Tibetan / East Asia)
nodes.notes: Three major 'super-grandfather' star expansions of Y-DNA O2 around ~6,000–5,000 BP in the Yellow River basin mirror the Neolithic consolidation remembered in the Yan-Huang (Yandi & Huangdi) traditions!

nodes.name: Y-DNA O1a + mtDNA B4a1a1 ('Polynesian Motif' — Taiwan → Lapita → Pacific!)
nodes.notes: Traces the Out-of-Taiwan Austronesian voyage through the Philippines, Lapita Melanesia (admixing with Papuan C1b2a), out to Tonga, Samoa, Hawaii, Aotearoa/New Zealand, and Rapa Nui — even detecting pre-Columbian contact with South America (~1200 CE)!

nodes.name: Y-DNA D (Jōmon Japan/Tibet), C2 (Steppe/Xiongnu) & N (Northern Eurasia)
nodes.role: Inner Asian Steppe & Jōmon-Yayoi Japanese Corridors
nodes.notes: Y-DNA D1a2 represents ancient Jōmon Japan (which admixed with Korean/Yayoi O1b2 arrivals to form modern Japanese!), while C2 & N anchor the Xiongnu, Turkic, and Mongol Steppe confederacies!

nodes.name: Y-DNA Q (Q-M242 → Q-M3) & mtDNA A2/B2/C1/D1 — Beringia to the Americas!
nodes.role: Peopling of North, Central & South America
nodes.notes: Ancestral Native Americans diverged in Siberia/Beringia carrying Y-DNA Q-M3 (sister branch of Eurasian R via P!) and mtDNA A2, B2, C1, D1, rapidly settling North America, Mesoamerica (Maya/Aztec), and the Andes (Inca)!

nodes.name: Seir the Horite → Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezer & Dishan
nodes.notes: Original Horite inhabitants of Mount Seir whose daughters (Timna, Oholibamah) intermarried with Esau and Eliphaz, merging Horites and Edomites.

nodes.name: Melchizedek (King & Priest of Salem)
nodes.role: King of Righteousness & Priest of El Elyon
nodes.notes: King of Salem (Jerusalem) who blesses Abraham. Book of Jasher 16:11 & Targums identify him with Shem son of Noah; his name ('King of Righteousness') also echoes Phoenician Sydyk in Sanchuniathon!

nodes.name: Job (Land of Uz) → Jemimah, Keziah & Keren-happuch
nodes.role: Righteous Patriarch of Uz & His 3 Friends + Elihu
nodes.notes: Dwelt in the Land of Uz; comforted/debated by Eliphaz the Temanite (Esau!), Bildad the Shuhite (Shuah/Abraham!), Zophar the Naamathite, and Elihu the Buzite (son of Barachel, from Nahor II's son Buz!).

nodes.name: Joshua (Hoshea son of Nun) & Caleb (son of Jephunneh)
nodes.role: Two Faithful Spies & Leaders Into Canaan
nodes.notes: Joshua (Tribe of Ephraim via Shuthelah -> Elishama -> Nun) succeeds Moses; Caleb the Kenizzite (Tribe of Judah, father of Achsah) conquers Hebron from the Anakim!

nodes.name: Zelophehad's 5 Daughters (Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, Tirzah) & Bezalel
nodes.role: Pioneers of Female Inheritance Law & Tabernacle Architect
nodes.notes: Manasseh -> Makir -> Gilead -> Hepher -> Zelophehad's 5 daughters established landmark inheritance rights in Israel; Judah -> Hezron -> Caleb -> Hur -> Uri -> Bezalel (+ Oholiab of Dan) crafted the Tabernacle & Ark!

nodes.name: Korah (Korahites), Asaph & Heman (Temple Singers)
nodes.notes: Izhar -> Korah -> Assir, Elkanah, Ebiasaph (ancestors of Samuel and the Korahite psalmists!), alongside Gershonite Asaph ('The Seer') and Kohathite Heman.

nodes.name: Arba → Anak (Anakim) → Sheshai, Ahiman, Talmai & Goliath of Gath
nodes.notes: Giants of Hebron (Kiriath-arba) linked in Num 13:33 to the Nephilim; remnants in Philistine Gath produce Goliath (+ brother Lahmi, slain by David & Elhanan).

nodes.name: Beor (of Pethor, Aram) → Balaam the Diviner
nodes.role: Aramean Seer Attested in the Deir Alla Inscription!
nodes.notes: Summoned by Moabite King Balak (son of Zippor) to curse Israel; archaeologically attested in the 8th-c. BCE Deir Alla plaster inscription in Jordan! Book of Jasher 72 also depicts Balaam rebelling in Cush against King Kikanos.

nodes.name: 1. Judge Othniel (son of Kenaz + Achsah)
nodes.notes: First Judge of Israel; nephew/brother of Caleb who marries Caleb's daughter Achsah.

nodes.name: 2. Judge Ehud (son of Gera, Benjamin)
nodes.notes: Left-handed Benjaminite deliverer who slew Moabite King Eglon.

nodes.name: 3. Judge Shamgar (son of Anath)
nodes.notes: Delivered Israel from 600 Philistines with an oxgoad.

nodes.name: 4. Judge Deborah (+ Barak) & Jael (+ Heber the Kenite)
nodes.notes: Prophetess & Judge who led Barak against Canaanite general Sisera; Jael (wife of Heber the Kenite, descendant of Midianite Hobab/Jethro!) slew Sisera.

nodes.name: 5. Judge Gideon (Jerubbaal) → Abimelech & Jotham
nodes.notes: Son of Joash (Abiezrite of Manasseh) who defeated Midian with 300 men; father of 70 sons including Abimelech, Jotham, and Jether.

nodes.name: 6. Judge Tola (Issachar) & 7. Judge Jair (Gilead)
nodes.notes: Tola (Issachar, judged 23 yrs) and Jair of Gilead (Manasseh, 30 sons riding 30 donkeys).

nodes.name: 8. Judge Jephthah (of Gilead)
nodes.notes: Mighty warrior of Gilead who delivered Israel from the Ammonites.

nodes.name: 9. Ibzan (Bethlehem), 10. Elon (Zebulun) & 11. Abdon
nodes.notes: Three minor Judges preceding Samson.

nodes.name: 12. Judge Samson (son of Manoah of Zorah, Dan)
nodes.notes: Nazirite strongman of the Tribe of Dan (+ Delilah) who battled the Philistines.

nodes.name: Judge & High Priest Eli → Hophni, Phinehas, Ichabod & Abiathar
nodes.notes: Descended from Aaron's son Ithamar; priest at Shiloh who mentored Samuel; line continues via Ahitub -> Ahimelech -> High Priest Abiathar under David.

nodes.name: Prophet & Judge Samuel (son of Elkanah & Hannah)
nodes.notes: Kohathite Levite (via Korah -> Elkanah & Hannah); final Judge who anointed BOTH King Saul and King David! Grandfather of Heman the Singer.

nodes.name: Aphiah → Abiel → Kish → King Saul (+ Ahinoam & Rizpah)
nodes.notes: Anointed by Samuel; father of Jonathan, Ish-bosheth (Esh-baal), Malki-shua, Merab, and Michal; uncle Ner fathered General Abner!

nodes.name: Jonathan (→ Mephibosheth), Ish-bosheth, Michal & General Abner
nodes.role: Royal Children & Commander of King Saul
nodes.notes: Jonathan (covenant friend of David; father of Mephibosheth -> Micah -> Eshek -> Ulam!), Michal (wife of David), Ish-bosheth (2nd brief king over northern tribes), and cousin Abner.

nodes.name: Jesse's House: Eliab, Zeruiah (→ Joab, Abishai, Asahel) & Abigail (→ Amasa)
nodes.notes: David's sister Zeruiah bore his three supreme commanders (Joab, Abishai, Asahel); sister Abigail married Jether the Ishmaelite and bore General Amasa!

nodes.name: Ahithophel → Eliam → Bathsheba (+ Uriah the Hittite)
nodes.notes: Bathsheba (daughter of Eliam, granddaughter of counselor Ahithophel) was wed to Uriah the Hittite before marrying King David and bearing Shimea, Shobab, Nathan (Luke 3 line!), and Solomon (Matthew 1 line!).

nodes.name: Hadad the Edomite (+ Sister of Queen Tahpenes of Egypt) → Genubath
nodes.role: Edomite Prince Raised in Pharaoh's Palace
nodes.notes: Fled Edom to Egypt, married the sister of Egyptian Queen Tahpenes (under Pharaoh Shishak/Siamun), and fathered Genubath — an explicit Biblical royal marriage uniting Egypt and Edom!

nodes.name: Rehoboam (1st King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Solomon & Naamah the Ammonitess; invaded by Pharaoh Shishak (Shoshenq I).

nodes.name: Abijah (Abijam)
nodes.notes: Son of Rehoboam & Queen Maacah (granddaughter of Absalom).

nodes.name: Asa (King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Reforming king who defeated Zerah the Cushite.

nodes.name: Jehoshaphat (King of Judah)
nodes.notes: Son of Asa & Azubah; allied with Ahab of Israel.

nodes.name: Jehoram (+ Queen Athaliah)
nodes.notes: Married Athaliah (daughter of Ahab & Jezebel!), uniting the royal houses of Judah, Israel, and Phoenician Sidon!

nodes.name: Ahaziah & Queen Athaliah (Sole Female Monarch of Judah)
nodes.notes: Ahaziah slain by Jehu; Queen Athaliah seized Judah's throne for 6 years until High Priest Jehoiada crowned young Joash.

nodes.name: Joash (Jehoash) → Amaziah
nodes.notes: Hidden in the Temple by Aunt Jehosheba & High Priest Jehoiada; father of Amaziah.

nodes.name: Uzziah (Azariah) → Jotham → Ahaz
nodes.notes: Uzziah (52-yr reign; era of Isaiah's call) -> Jotham -> Ahaz (vassal of Tiglath-Pileser III).

nodes.name: King Hezekiah (+ Hephzibah)
nodes.notes: Withstood Sennacherib's siege of Jerusalem alongside Prophet Isaiah & Cushite Pharaoh Taharqa (Tirhakah)! Ancestor of Prophet Zephaniah.

nodes.name: Manasseh (55 yrs) → Amon
nodes.notes: Longest-reigning king of Judah; vassal of Esarhaddon & Ashurbanipal.

nodes.name: King Josiah (+ Zebidah & Hamutal)
nodes.notes: Great Deuteronomic reformer; fell at Megiddo confronting Pharaoh Neco II of Egypt (609 BCE). Father of Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim, and Zedekiah.

nodes.name: Jehoahaz, Jehoiakim & King Zedekiah (Fall of Jerusalem, 586 BCE)
nodes.notes: Three sons of Josiah who reigned during Babylon's conquest; Zedekiah was final king before Babylonian Exile.

nodes.name: Jehoiachin (Jeconiah) → Shealtiel → Zerubbabel
nodes.notes: Son of Jehoiakim carried to Babylon (attested in Babylonian ration tablets!); grandfather of Zerubbabel, Governor of Yehud under Cyrus & Darius I!

nodes.name: 1. Jeroboam I (son of Nebat, Ephraim) → 2. Nadab
nodes.notes: First King of the Northern Kingdom of Israel (10 tribes); sheltered earlier by Pharaoh Shishak in Egypt.

nodes.name: 3. Baasha → 4. Elah → 5. Zimri
nodes.notes: Second northern dynasty (Issachar) followed by 7-day reign of Zimri.

nodes.name: 6. Omri → 7. King Ahab (+ Queen Jezebel of Sidon!) → 8. Ahaziah & 9. Joram
nodes.notes: House of Omri (attested on the Mesha Stele & Assyrian Kurkh Monolith!). Ahab married Princess Jezebel, daughter of Ethbaal King of Tyre/Sidon — exact same Ethbaal who is great-uncle of Queen Dido of Carthage!

nodes.name: 10. Jehu → 11. Jehoahaz → 12. Jehoash → 13. Jeroboam II → 14. Zechariah
nodes.notes: Jehu (attested bowing on Shalmaneser III's Black Obelisk!) overthrew Omri's house; Jeroboam II led northern Israel's peak prosperity.

nodes.name: 15. Shallum → 16. Menahem → 17. Pekahiah → 18. Pekah → 19. Hoshea (722 BCE)
nodes.notes: Final kings of Northern Israel before Samaria fell to Assyria (Shalmaneser V / Sargon II, 722 BCE — Assyrian Exile!).

nodes.name: Eleazar → Phinehas → Abishua → High Priest Zadok
nodes.role: Perpetual High Priestly Line of Zadok
nodes.notes: Aaron (+ Elisheba, sister of Judahite prince Nahshon!) -> Eleazar -> Phinehas -> Abishua -> Bukki -> Uzzi -> Zerahiah -> Meraioth -> Amariah -> Ahitub -> Zadok (David & Solomon's High Priest!).

nodes.name: Hilkiah → Seraiah → Jehozadak → High Priest Joshua → Jaddua & Ezra
nodes.era: Exile → Persian Period (1 Chr 6; Ezra 7; Neh 12)
nodes.notes: Seraiah -> Jehozadak -> High Priest Joshua (rebuilt Temple with Zerubbabel) -> Joiakim -> Eliashib -> Joiada -> Jonathan -> Jaddua (who greeted Alexander the Great in Josephus!) & Priest-Scribe Ezra (commissioned by Artaxerxes I!).

nodes.name: Zechariah & Elizabeth (Priestly Division of Abijah) → John the Baptist
nodes.notes: Descended from Aaron via Abijah; Elizabeth was a kinswoman of Mary, bridging the Levitical priestly line and the Davidic line of Jesus!

nodes.name: Prophet Elijah (Tishbite) & Prophet Elisha (son of Shaphat)
nodes.role: Prophets Opposing House of Ahab & Baal
nodes.notes: Elijah confronted Ahab & Jezebel on Mt. Carmel and ascended in a whirlwind; Elisha anointed Hazael of Syria and Jehu of Israel.

nodes.name: Prophet Isaiah (son of Amoz) & Prophet Zephaniah (Hezekiah's Line)
nodes.notes: Isaiah (+ sons Shear-jashub & Maher-shalal-hash-baz) counseled Kings Uzziah through Hezekiah; Zephaniah 1:1 traces Zephaniah (son of Cushi -> Gedaliah -> Amariah -> Hezekiah) directly to King Hezekiah!

nodes.name: Prophet Jeremiah (+ Scribe Baruch) & Prophet Ezekiel (son of Buzi)
nodes.notes: Priestly prophets witnessing the fall of Jerusalem (586 BCE) and exile to Babylon; Baruch (son of Neriah) preserved Jeremiah's scrolls.

nodes.name: Prophet Daniel (Belteshazzar), Shadrach/Meshach/Abednego & Nehemiah
nodes.notes: Daniel (royal Judean youth) & companions Hananiah, Mishael, Azariah served under Nebuchadnezzar, Cyrus, and Darius; Nehemiah (son of Hacaliah) served as cupbearer to Artaxerxes I at Susa before rebuilding Jerusalem's walls!

nodes.name: Hosea (+ Gomer), Amos, Jonah, Micah, Habakkuk & Zechariah
nodes.role: Prophets of Israel, Nineveh & Post-Exilic Judah
nodes.notes: Hosea (son of Beeri + Gomer -> Jezreel, Lo-ruhamah, Lo-ammi), Amos, Jonah (sent to Nineveh!), Micah, Habakkuk, and Zechariah (son of Berechiah son of Iddo).

nodes.name: Jair → Mordecai & Queen Esther (Hadassah) vs. Haman the Agagite
nodes.era: 5th c. BCE (Susa / Persia — Book of Esther)
nodes.role: Benjaminite Queen of Persia & Defeat of Amalekite Haman
nodes.notes: Benjamin -> Kish -> Shimei -> Jair -> Mordecai & cousin Hadassah (Queen Esther), wed to Persian Emperor Ahasuerus (Xerxes I), thwarting Haman son of Hammedatha the Agagite (descendant of Amalekite King Agag -> Esau's grandson Amalek!).

nodes.name: Abiud → Eliakim → Azor → Matthan → Jacob → Joseph (Matthew 1 Line)
nodes.role: Legal Royal Line from Solomon & Zerubbabel to Joseph
nodes.notes: Complete Matthew 1 genealogy: Zerubbabel -> Abiud -> Eliakim -> Azor -> Zadok -> Achim -> Eliud -> Eleazar -> Matthan -> Jacob -> Joseph (husband of Mary).

nodes.name: Nathan → Mattatha → Neri → Matthat → Heli → Mary (Luke 3 Line)
nodes.role: Luke 3 Davidic Line via Nathan to Mary
nodes.notes: Complete Luke 3 genealogy through David's son Nathan (via Mattatha, Melea, Eliakim, Jonam, Neri, Rhesa, Joanan, Matthat, Heli -> Mary, mother of Jesus!).

nodes.name: Jesus of Nazareth ('The Christ') & Siblings (James, Joses, Simon, Jude)
nodes.role: Culmination of Both Matthew 1 & Luke 3 Genealogies
nodes.notes: Born in Bethlehem of Mary (Luke 3 line) & legal son of Joseph (Matthew 1 line) during Caesar Augustus & Herod the Great; chart also notes brothers James (leader of Jerusalem church), Joseph/Joses, Simon, and Judas/Jude.

nodes.name: Apostle Paul (Saul of Tarsus — Tribe of Benjamin)
nodes.role: Benjaminite Pharisee & Apostle to the Mediterranean
nodes.notes: Born in Tarsus (Cilicia — cf. Cilix/Tarshish!) of the Tribe of Benjamin; carried the Judeo-Christian movement across Anatolia, Greece (Athens/Corinth), and Rome!

nodes.name: Antipater the Idumean → Herod the Great → Archelaus, Antipas & Philip
nodes.notes: Antipater of Idumea (Edom — Esau's land!) allied with Julius Caesar; his son Herod the Great rebuilt the Second Temple and fathered Archelaus, Herod Antipas (+ Herodias & Salome), and Herod Philip — bridging Edom directly into Imperial Rome and the Gospels!

nodes.name: Merodach-baladan → Nebuchadnezzar II → Evil-merodach (Neo-Babylon)
nodes.role: Conqueror of Jerusalem & Builder of Babylon's Ishtar Gate
nodes.notes: Nebuchadnezzar II besieged Jerusalem (597 & 586 BCE), exiled Jehoiachin and Daniel, and built the Hanging Gardens/Ishtar Gate; succeeded by Evil-merodach (Amel-Marduk) who released King Jehoiachin!

nodes.name: Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) → Sennacherib → Esarhaddon → Ashurbanipal
nodes.role: Assyrian Emperors of the Biblical Books of Kings & Isaiah
nodes.notes: Tiglath-Pileser III (Pul) exacted tribute from Israel/Judah; Sennacherib besieged Hezekiah (Taylor Prism) before being slain by sons Adrammelech & Sharezer; Esarhaddon & Ashurbanipal (Osnappar) conquered Egypt (Taharqa)!

nodes.name: King Hiram of Tyre, King Mesha of Moab (Mesha Stele) & Hazael of Aram
nodes.role: Levantine Monarchs Attested in Bible & Inscriptions
nodes.notes: Hiram of Tyre supplied cedar & craftsman Huram-Abi for Solomon's Temple; King Mesha of Moab's 840 BCE Stele mentions Omri, Israel & 'House of David'; King Hazael of Damascus (Tel Dan Stele) fought Jehoram & Ahaziah!

nodes.name: Pharaoh Neco II (26th Saite Dynasty of Egypt)
nodes.role: Pharaoh at Battle of Megiddo (609 BCE) & Carchemish (605 BCE)
nodes.notes: Marched north to aid Assyria against Babylon, slaying King Josiah at Megiddo (609 BCE) and installing Jehoiakim; Herodotus credits Neco II with commissioning Phoenician sailors to circumnavigate Africa!

nodes.name: Hezron → Jerahmeel, Ram, Caleb (Chelubai) & Ashhur
nodes.role: Founders of the Four Great Clans of Judah
nodes.notes: Hezron (son of Perez) fathers Jerahmeel, Ram (ancestral line to David via Amminadab -> Nahshon -> Salmon + Rahab -> Boaz), Caleb/Chelubai (+ Azubah, Jerioth, Ephrath -> Hur), and posthumously Ashhur (father of Tekoa via Abijah).

nodes.name: Hur (son of Caleb & Ephrath) → Uri → Bezalel (Tabernacle Architect)
nodes.role: Chief Craftsman of the Ark & Tabernacle
nodes.notes: Hur (who held up Moses's hands at Rephidim alongside Aaron) fathers Uri -> Bezalel, Shobal (father of Kiriath-jearim), Salma (father of Bethlehem), and Hareph (father of Beth-gader).

nodes.name: Elimelech & Naomi → Mahlon (+ Ruth) & Chilion (+ Orpah)
nodes.notes: Elimelech and Naomi migrate from Bethlehem to Moab; their sons Mahlon and Chilion marry Moabite women Ruth and Orpah. After Mahlon's death, Boaz redeems Ruth, fathering Obed -> Jesse -> King David.

nodes.name: Jesse & Nitzevet → Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem & David
nodes.role: Complete Household of Jesse of Bethlehem
nodes.notes: Talmudic tradition names David's mother Nitzevet bat Adael. Jesse's seven sons (Eliab, Abinadab, Shimea/Shammah -> Jonadab, Nethanel, Raddai, Ozem, David) and two daughters (Zeruiah -> Joab/Abishai/Asahel; Abigail + Ithra/Jether -> Amasa).

nodes.name: King David's Complete Household (8 Wives & 19 Named Sons + Tamar)
nodes.role: Full Royal House of David in Hebron & Jerusalem
nodes.notes: Hebron sons: Amnon (by Ahinoam), Chileab/Daniel (by Abigail), Absalom & Tamar (by Maacah bat Talmai of Geshur), Adonijah (by Haggith), Shephatiah (by Abital), Ithream (by Eglah). Jerusalem sons: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan (Luke 3 line!), Solomon (by Bathsheba), plus Ibhar, Elishua, Eliphelet, Nogah, Nepheg, Japhia, Elishama, Eliada & Jerimoth.

nodes.name: Eliab (Reuben) → Nemuel, Dathan & Abiram (Korah's Rebellion)
nodes.role: Reubenite Leaders of the Wilderness Revolt
nodes.notes: Pallu -> Eliab -> Dathan and Abiram, who joined Korah the Levite in challenging Moses and Aaron in the wilderness. Also Reubenite Prince Elizur son of Shedeur & Shammua son of Zaccur (spy).

nodes.name: 24 Levitical Priestly Courses (Jehoiarib, Abijah, Zadok) & Temple Musicians
nodes.notes: King David organized Aaron's descendants (16 courses of Eleazar, 8 of Ithamar) into 24 priestly rotations: 1. Jehoiarib (Hasmonean/Maccabee clan!), 8. Abijah (Zechariah father of John the Baptist!). Alongside Temple Choirs of Gershon (Asaph), Kohath (Heman), and Merari (Ethan/Jeduthun).

nodes.name: Machir (Manasseh) → Gilead → Hepher → Zelophehad & Jair
nodes.notes: Machir (son of Manasseh & an Aramean concubine) -> Gilead -> Iezer (ancestor of Gideon!), Helek, Asriel, Shechem, Shemida, and Hepher -> Zelophehad (whose 5 daughters Mahlah, Noah, Hoglah, Milcah, Tirzah established female inheritance law in Israel!).

nodes.name: Ephraim → Beriah & Sherah → Resheph → Elishama → Nun → Joshua
nodes.notes: 1 Chronicles 7 records Ephraim's daughter Sherah (who built Lower & Upper Beth-horon!) and traces Beriah -> Rephah -> Resheph -> Telah -> Tahan -> Ladan -> Ammihud -> Elishama (Prince of Ephraim) -> Nun -> Joshua (Yehoshua).

nodes.name: Jeiel / Abiel → Ner → General Abner & Kish → King Saul's Sons
nodes.role: Complete Benjamite Royal House of Saul
nodes.notes: Abiel fathers Kish (father of King Saul) and Ner (father of General Abner, commander of Saul's army). Saul's sons: Jonathan (-> Mephibosheth -> Mica), Abinadab, Malchishua, Ish-bosheth (Eshbaal), plus Armoni & Mephibosheth (by Rizpah bat Aiah), and daughters Merab & Michal.

nodes.name: Jeroboam I & Queen Ano (Egyptian Princess) → Abijah & Nadab
nodes.role: Egyptian Royal Marriage of Israel's First Northern King
nodes.notes: The Greek Septuagint preserves the name Ano, sister-in-law of Pharaoh Shishak (Shoshenq I), given in marriage to Jeroboam I during his Egyptian exile — linking the Northern Kingdom of Israel directly to Egypt's 22nd Dynasty!

nodes.name: 8 Early Kings of Edom (Bela ben Beor through Hadar & Queen Mehetabel)
nodes.notes: Eight kings who reigned in Edom before any king reigned over Israel: 1. Bela ben Beor (Dinhabah), 2. Jobab ben Zerah of Bozrah, 3. Husham (Temanites), 4. Hadad ben Bedad (defeated Midian), 5. Samlah (Masrekah), 6. Shaul (Rehoboth), 7. Baal-hanan ben Achbor, 8. Hadar/Hadad (+ Mehetabel bat Matred).

nodes.name: High Priest Jeshua (Joshua) → Joiakim → Eliashib → Joiada → Johanan → Jaddua
nodes.role: Persian-Era High Priests of the Second Temple
nodes.notes: Continuous post-exilic Zadokite succession from Seraiah -> Jehozadak -> Jeshua (rebuilt Second Temple with Zerubbabel) down to Jaddua, who according to Josephus (Ant. XI.8.5) met Alexander the Great at Jerusalem in 332 BCE! Jaddua's brother Manasseh married Nikaso daughter of Sanballat and founded the Samaritan Temple on Mount Gerizim.

nodes.name: Oniad High Priests: Onias I → Simon I the Just → Eleazar → Onias II → Simon II → Onias III
nodes.notes: Eleazar sent the 72 scholars to Ptolemy II Philadelphus in Alexandria to translate the Torah into Greek (the Septuagint!). Onias III's brother Jason Hellenized Jerusalem; Onias III's son Onias IV fled to Egypt and built the Jewish Temple at Leontopolis, fathering Helkias & Ananias (generals of Queen Cleopatra III!).

nodes.name: Mattathias of Modi'in (Priest of Course of Jehoiarib)
nodes.era: c. 167 BCE (1 Macc 2; Josephus Ant. XII.6)
nodes.notes: Priest of the line of Joarib/Jehoiarib (son of John, son of Simeon, son of Asamonaeus/Hasmon) who sparked the revolt against Seleucid King Antiochus IV Epiphanes. Father of 5 sons: John Gaddi, Simon Thassi, Judas Maccabeus, Eleazar Avaran, and Jonathan Apphus.

nodes.name: Judas Maccabeus ('The Hammer'), John Gaddi, Eleazar Avaran & Jonathan Apphus
nodes.notes: Judas Maccabeus rededicated the Second Temple in 164 BCE (origin of Hanukkah); Eleazar Avaran died crushing a Seleucid war elephant; Jonathan Apphus became the first Hasmonean High Priest (152-143 BCE).

nodes.name: Simon Thassi (Ethnarch) → John Hyrcanus I (134-104 BCE)
nodes.role: Founders of the Independent Hasmonean State
nodes.notes: Simon Thassi won full independence from the Seleucids; his son John Hyrcanus I expanded Judea, conquered Samaria and Idumea (converting the Edomites/Idumeans — ancestors of Herod the Great!).

nodes.name: Aristobulus I (1st King) & Alexander Jannaeus + Queen Salome Alexandra
nodes.role: Hasmonean Kings & Sole Regnant Queen of Judea
nodes.notes: Aristobulus I (Judah) assumed the royal diadem; his brother Alexander Jannaeus married Salome Alexandra, who ruled Judea in her own right (76-67 BCE) — a golden age of Pharisaic scholarship.

nodes.name: Hyrcanus II & Aristobulus II → Alexander II, Antigonus II & Mariamne I
nodes.role: Last Hasmonean Rulers & Bridge to the Herodian Dynasty
nodes.notes: Civil war between brothers Hyrcanus II and Aristobulus II brought Pompey and Rome into Jerusalem (63 BCE). Hyrcanus II's daughter Alexandra married Aristobulus II's son Alexander II, producing Aristobulus III (last Hasmonean High Priest) and Princess Mariamne I — who married Herod the Great!

nodes.name: Antipas → Antipater the Idumean & Cypros (Nabataean Princess)
nodes.role: Idumean-Nabataean Founders of the Herodian House
nodes.notes: Antipater (chief minister of Hyrcanus II, appointed Procurator of Judea by Julius Caesar) married Nabataean princess Cypros, fathering Phasael I, Herod I the Great, Joseph I, Pheroras, and Salome I (+ Costobarus).

nodes.name: Herod I the Great (10 Wives) → Antipater II, Alexander, Aristobulus IV, Archelaus, Antipas & Philip
nodes.role: Roman Client King of Judea & Builder of the Second Temple
nodes.notes: Married Doris (Antipater II), Hasmonean Mariamne I (Alexander + Glaphyra of Cappadocia; Aristobulus IV + Berenice), Mariamne II bat Simon Boethus (Herod II Philip), Malthace (Archelaus, Herod Antipas), Cleopatra of Jerusalem (Philip the Tetrarch), and 5 other wives.

nodes.name: Aristobulus IV & Berenice → King Herod Agrippa I, Herod of Chalcis & Herodias (+ Salome)
nodes.era: c. 10 BCE – 93 CE (Acts 12, 25-26; Josephus Ant. XVIII-XX)
nodes.role: Final Herodian Monarchs & Emesa/Armenia Royal Marriages
nodes.notes: Herod Agrippa I (+ Cypros) fathered King Herod Agrippa II, Berenice II, Mariamne, and Drusilla (+ Roman Governor Felix). Herodias (wife of Herod II Philip, then Herod Antipas) was mother of Princess Salome. Aristobulus Minor married Salome; Mariamne's line intermarried with Sampsiceramus II (Priest-King of Emesa) and Tigranes V/VI of Armenia!

nodes.name: Joachim (Heli) & Saint Anne → Blessed Virgin Mary
nodes.role: Maternal Grandparents of Jesus of Nazareth
nodes.notes: Early Christian tradition (Protoevangelium of James) names Mary's parents Joachim (often harmonized with Heli of Luke 3:23) and Anne; Anne's sister Sobe is traditionally mother of Elizabeth (mother of John the Baptist).

nodes.name: Alphaeus (Clopas) & Mary of Clopas → James the Lesser & Jude Thaddeus
nodes.era: 1st c. CE (Matt 10:3; John 19:25; Eusebius HE III.11)
nodes.role: Holy Family Kinsmen & Early Bishops of Jerusalem
nodes.notes: Hegesippus (in Eusebius) records Clopas as brother of Joseph of Nazareth; his son Simeon became the 2nd Bishop of Jerusalem after James the Just! Gervais UsefulChart links Alphaeus/Clopas & Mary of Clopas to Apostles James the Lesser and Jude Thaddeus.

nodes.name: Zebedee & Salome → Apostle James the Great & Apostle John the Evangelist
nodes.role: Sons of Thunder (Boanerges) — Inner Circle Apostles
nodes.notes: Galilean fishermen brothers James the Great (martyred under Herod Agrippa I, Acts 12:2) and John the Beloved/Evangelist (author of Fourth Gospel & Revelation).

nodes.name: Jonah (John) of Bethsaida → Apostle Simon Peter & Apostle Andrew
nodes.role: Chief Apostles of Galilee, Rome & Constantinople
nodes.notes: Simon Peter (Cephas, traditional 1st Bishop of Rome) and his brother Andrew (traditional founder of Byzantium/Constantinople see).

nodes.name: Apostles Philip, Bartholomew (Nathanael), Matthew (Levi), Thomas, Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot & Matthias
nodes.role: Complete College of the Twelve Apostles
nodes.notes: Completes the Twelve Apostles: Philip of Bethsaida, Bartholomew/Nathanael, Matthew/Levi (son of Alphaeus), Thomas Didymus (traditional Apostle to India!), Simon the Zealot, Judas Iscariot (son of Simon), and his replacement Matthias.

nodes.name: Mary Magdalene, Joseph of Arimathea, Nicodemus, Lazarus/Martha/Mary, Mark, Luke & Timothy
nodes.role: Key New Testament Households & Early Church Chroniclers
nodes.notes: Includes Mary Magdalene, Sanhedrin disciples Joseph of Arimathea & Nicodemus, Bethany siblings Lazarus/Martha/Mary, Barnabas & John Mark (cousins, Col 4:10), Luke the Physician, and Timothy (son of Eunice, grandson of Lois, 2 Tim 1:5).

nodes.name: Josephus's Table of Nations Key (Gomer=Gauls, Magog=Scythians, Tubal=Iberians, Meshech=Cappadocians, Tiras=Thracians)
nodes.notes: Flavius Josephus systematically mapped Genesis 10 into 1st-century Greco-Roman geography: Gomer=Galatians/Gauls, Magog=Scythians, Madai=Medes, Javan=Ionians/Greeks, Tubal=Iberes, Meshech=Cappadocians (Mazaca), Tiras=Thracians, Ashkenaz=Rheginians, Riphath=Paphlagonians, Togarmah=Phrygians, Elishah=Aeolians, Tarshish=Cilicia (Tarsus), Kittim=Cyprus (Kition).

nodes.name: Syriac Antediluvian Matriarchs: Lebhûdhâ (Cain's Twin/Wife), Ķelîmath/Aklia (Abel's Twin, Seth's Wife) & Haykêl bat Namûs (Noah's Wife)
nodes.era: Antediluvian Syriac Tradition (Cave of Treasures pp. 69-100, 197-198)
nodes.role: Complete Syriac Matriarchal Chain from Eve to Noah's Wife Haykêl
nodes.notes: Names every matriarch across 10 antediluvian generations: Cain + twin Lebhûdhâ; Seth + Ķelîmath (Abel's twin); Enos + Ḥannâ; Cainan + Peryath; Mahalalel + Şeḥatpar; Jared + Zebhîdhâ; Enoch + Zadhkîn; Methuselah + Sâkhûth; Lamech + Kîpâr; Noah + Haykêl (daughter of Namûs)! Also names Terah's 2 wives: Yônâ (mother of Abraham) & Salmûth (mother of Sarah).

nodes.name: Yônṭôn (4th Son of Noah!) — Sage of Lake Aṭrâs & Teacher of Nimrod's 'Gelyânâ'
nodes.role: Post-Diluvian 4th Son of Noah & Origin of Eastern Magian Astronomy
nodes.notes: Born to Noah after the Flood and sent east to Yôkdôrâ of Nôdh by Lake Aṭrâs! Nimrod journeyed east to Yônṭôn for 3 years and received the astronomical 'Revelation (Gelyânâ) of Nimrod' — the very star-prophecy later followed by the Magi to Bethlehem!

nodes.name: Syriac Melchizedek Lineage: Mâlâkh (son of Arphaxad/Cainan) & Yôzâdhâk → Melchizedek
nodes.role: Syriac Parentage of Melchizedek & Guardian of Adam's Body at Golgotha
nodes.notes: Unlike rabbinic Shem=Melchizedek, the Syriac Cave of Treasures names Melchizedek's parents as Mâlâkh (brother of Salah, grandson of Arphaxad) and Yôzâdhâk (Book of the Bee variant: Harklêîm & Shêlâthîêl). Shem led 15-year-old Melchizedek to entomb Adam's body at Golgotha!

nodes.name: Syriac Twin Fathers of Joseph & Mary: Matthan + Sebhrath → Twins Jacob (→ Joseph) & Yônâkhîr (+ Dînâ/Ḥannâ → Mary)
nodes.role: Syriac Harmonization Making Joseph & Virgin Mary First Cousins!
nodes.notes: Preserves EVERY post-exilic matriarch from Zerubbabel (+ Malkath bat Ezra!) through Abiud (+ Zakhyath bat Joshua) to Matthan (+ Sebhrath bat Phinehas), who bore TWINS Jacob (father of Joseph by Ḥadbhîth) and Yônâkhîr (father of Mary by Dînâ/Ḥannâ)!

nodes.name: The Magi Kings of the East: Hôrmîzdâdh (Persia), Îzgarad (Sâbhâ) & Perôzadh (Sheba) + 12 Magi (Book of the Bee)
